decks.notes: The deck focuses on achieving a powerful combo using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The strategy involves using Wrenn and Six as a resource engine to consistently find combo pieces and disrupt the opponent with spells like Spell Pierce and Fatal Push. The deck aims to be creative in its approach by utilizing cards that are not commonly seen in competitive Modern decks, creating a unique and unexpected gameplay experience for the pilot.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Leyline Binding, Indomitable Creativity, and Transmogrify to exile high-cost permanents and cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. By combining control elements such as Teferi, Time Raveler and counter spells with the creativity of the combo pieces, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with unexpected threats and disruptive plays. Additionally, the inclusion of Wrenn and Six helps to maintain consistent land drops and provide card advantage, setting up the combo while also controlling the board.

The deck aims to utilize the combination of Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to continuously mill and recur cards from the graveyard, generating infinite loops to win the game. It also uses artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber to enable these combos, while also providing card draw and mana acceleration. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer helps generate additional value and board presence, while disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler provide protection and disruption against opposing strategies.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to generate early pressure through efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by disruptive spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The deck aims to maintain the tempo and aggression by using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to filter through the deck and find the necessary cards to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Ledger Shredder provide additional threats and disruption to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively cast spells with cascade abilities to overwhelm your opponent. By casting spells for free and triggering cascade effects, you can quickly flood the board with creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck focuses on tempo and card advantage, using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls. Boseiju, Who Endures is included to ensure your cascade spells resolve, while cards like Force of Negation provide protection against opposing spells. Ultimately, the goal is to maintain pressure and momentum to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade effects, generating card advantage and putting pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of creatures and disruptive spells. The inclusion of counter spells like Force of Negation adds protection while cards like Brazen Borrower provide tempo plays. The deck aims to control the board and win the game through aggressive cascading and efficient spell casting.

This deck focuses on casting low-cost spells with the Cascade mechanic to quickly swarm the board with creatures and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cascade into powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Crashing Footfalls, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and apply constant pressure. Key cards like Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower provide disruption and flexibility, allowing the deck to adapt to various situations and maintain its aggressive strategy.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Counterspell and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes graveyard synergies with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Murktide Regent. By efficiently managing resources and maintaining pressure on the opponent, this deck aims to close out games swiftly before the opponent can stabilize. It also includes a mix of protection and card selection spells to maintain consistency and flexibility in different matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, aiming to deal as much damage as possible as quickly as possible. The deck utilizes a mix of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf, alongside efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around applying early pressure and maintaining control of the board to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, while controlling the board with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and leyline binding. The deck seeks to assemble the combo of Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive damage to the opponent in one turn. The deck also includes versatile cards like Bring to Light and Wrenn and Six to provide flexibility in different situations and ensure consistent performance.

The deck focuses on casting spells with cascade to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By chaining together cascade spells with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to flood the board with threats like Crashing Footfalls and Leyline Binding. Additionally, the deck includes interaction like Force of Negation and removal spells to control the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize the chances of casting cascade spells early in the game.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively with cards like Death's Shadow, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to pressure opponents quickly. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's strategy, coupled with removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt, it aims to control the game. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Underworld Breach allows for potential combo plays. The deck's mana base is optimized to support its aggressive playstyle with fetch lands and shock lands for consistent and efficient mana fixing.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. The deck also utilizes Elemental creatures like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value and pressure opponents. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize its efficiency. By combining control elements with Elemental synergies, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in the late game.

The deck focuses on using a combination of control elements and elemental creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value from ETB triggers and card advantage. The deck utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, along with versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending. The elemental creatures like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation help to ramp up and apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes a toolbox of creatures like Endurance and Solitude to deal with specific threats. Additionally, the inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional synergy and support for the elemental theme.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the powerful equipment package of Colossus Hammer, Kaldra Compleat, and Nettlecyst onto creatures like Ornithopter and Inkmoth Nexus to create a lethal threat that can win the game in just a few swings. The deck aims to use Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to quickly find and equip these powerful artifacts, while also protecting them with cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce. Urza's Saga also plays a key role in finding the necessary artifacts to combo off and win the game.

This deck focuses on quickly reducing the opponent's life total through aggressive creatures and disruption spells. By utilizing cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to strip key cards from the opponent's hand, along with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate, the deck aims to control the board while pushing damage through with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Feign Death provide additional value and ways to pressure the opponent. Additionally, disruptive elements like Blood Moon can further hinder the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, to enable powerful combos with Underworld Breach. By utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Expressive Iteration, the deck aims to dig through the library efficiently to find key pieces. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and resources. With a mix of disruption and card advantage, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its combo potential and aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to continuously loop through your graveyard and exile to mill your opponent's library or win with Thassa's Oracle. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station help to facilitate this combo, while cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Mishra's Bauble provide card advantage. Urza's Saga and Mox Amber help to ramp and generate mana, while disruption cards like Lightning Bolt and Teferi, Time Raveler control the board. The deck aims to efficiently set up the combo and win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost and efficient burn spells and creatures. By maintaining a fast pace and continuously applying pressure with cards like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Boros Charm adds versatility and resilience to the strategy, while cards like Searing Blaze and Skullcrack help to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressively casting creatures and spells with the Cascade mechanic to generate maximum value and overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the player can cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury to put pressure on their opponent. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Negation and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own threats. With a diverse mana base and a mix of creatures and spells, this deck aims to win through a combination of speed and disruption.

This deck focuses on using cards that allow for creativity in creating powerful combos. The deck includes cards that manipulate opponent's hands, deal damage, counter spells, and return cards from the graveyard. The main strategy is to use cards like Indomitable Creativity to create powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty, while utilizing Leyline Binding to control the opponent's board. The deck also includes support cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler to provide additional control and card advantage. The mana base includes a mix of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent color access.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip a creature with an enormous power and toughness, allowing for a fast win condition. The deck utilizes various equipment tutors like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift to find the pieces it needs quickly. The inclusion of cards like Esper Sentinel and Urza's Saga provide additional value and card advantage to help maintain momentum and outpace the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, lethal threat in a short amount of time.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively gain large amounts of life through the Martyr Life mechanic, which involves sacrificing creatures to gain life equal to their converted mana cost. This allows the player to stay alive and dominate the board while also having access to powerful control elements like removal spells and counter magic. The deck also utilizes cards that tutor for specific creatures, such as Eladamri's Call, and has ways to bring back creatures from the graveyard or exile, such as Brought Back and Emeria, the Sky Ruin. Overall, it aims to control the game through lifegain and creature manipulation while maintaining a strong board presence.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of disruptive elements. It aims to quickly attack the opponent while using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to generate board presence. Grief and Thoughtseize help to disrupt the opponent's hand, while cards like Terminate and Fatal Push provide removal options. The deck also includes protection and recursion with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Malakir Rebirth. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon adds another layer of disruption, while Lightning Bolt provides additional direct damage. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells, quickly reducing their life total before they can stabilize. By combining efficient threats like Ragavan and Seasoned Pyromancer with disruptive spells like Grief and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure on the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Fury and Feign Death allows for unexpected combat tricks and extra value, while cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt provide removal options. Additionally, the inclusion of Blood Moon can disrupt the opponent's mana base, giving the deck an edge in certain matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly mill the opponent's library using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap while controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch. Visions of Beyond helps draw more cards as the opponent's library shrinks, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter can exile a significant portion of their library. Fractured Sanity can mill even more cards while also providing a possible win condition with its second ability. Jace, the Perfected Mind can help with card advantage and control, ultimately leading to a win through milling.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on aggressive early game plays using cheap spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Manamorphose and Mishra's Bauble for card advantage, while creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Sprite Dragon grow in power with each spell cast. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to finish off opponents. With the addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, the deck gains access to additional mana acceleration for explosive turns.

The main theme of this UR Aggro deck is to disrupt opponents with counterspells like Spell Snare, Remand, and Spell Pierce while quickly overwhelming them with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with Underworld Breach and includes versatile cards like Expressive Iteration and Consider for added consistency. Blood Moon can shut down opponents' mana bases, allowing the deck to easily close out games. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as an additional resource for extra mana ramp.

The deck focuses on aggressive play using low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes cards that allow for card advantage and graveyard recursion to maintain momentum throughout the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional versatility and consistency to the deck. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats while disrupting their game plan with removal and burn spells.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Blood Moon and Utopia Sprawl, while also generating value with cards like Wrenn and Six and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck can quickly ramp into powerful threats like Migloz, Maze Crusher and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also controlling the board with cards like Lightning Bolt and Fury. Klothys, God of Destiny provides additional value and disruption, making it difficult for opponents to stabilize. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents while maintaining control of the game.

The main idea behind this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and various cards that can disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to generate card advantage and control the board. The inclusion of cards like Archmage's Charm and Leyline Binding further enhances the controlling aspect of the deck. Additionally, the deck makes use of unique cards like Dress Down and Brokers Charm to deal with a variety of threats while maintaining a strong board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence of small creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Esper Sentinel. Utilizing powerful anthem effects like Force of Virtue and Shining Shoal, as well as aggressive attackers like Champion of the Parish and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a barrage of creatures. The inclusion of Solitude provides removal options, while Sanctifier en-Vec helps protect against graveyard strategies. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent casting of creatures and spells.
